Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P0 - hosted-inference-us-west-2: spike in 5xx responses (TPS up x3). Paging primary oncall.
Maya Li: seeing the spike on dashboard, much higher error rate on generate path. Investigating logs now.
Ben Torres: I'm primary for this shift — taking it. Will start mitigation.
Carla Gomez: ping if you want me to flip traffic to dedicated pool as a quick fallback.
Ben Torres: thanks Carla — hold that as option. First steps: check KV cache hit rate, autoscale, and model variant fallback.
Ben Torres: runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike — follow steps 1-4.
Maya Li: copying important logs below (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-14T08:20:12Z] inference: request_id=abc123 status=500 err="kv cache miss + OOM in attention kernel"
[2026-03-14T08:20:15Z] routing: region=us-west-2 pool=hosted-realtime latency_ms=850 error_rate=12.4%
[2026-03-14T08:20:18Z] model_server: model=v2.1 quantized=false evicting_kv=124ms
```
Ben Torres: mitigation plan: (1) scale pool replicas + enable cache warmup, (2) route small fraction to fallback model v2.0, (3) if errors persist, failover to dedicated pool.
Ben Torres: scaling pool now:
```bash
redwoodctl scale-pool --region us-west-2 --pool hosted-realtime --replicas 6
```
deploy-bot: Deploy action: traffic shift initiated: routed 10% -> model v2.0 in us-west-2 (id: deploy-7782).
Maya Li: after scaling + 10% fallback, 5xx dropped to ~3.2% and p99 latency down ~200ms. Good signal but still above SLO.
